Everything's integrated and nothing regressed — save, edit, duplicate, tags, notes, search, and now read/finished all work together. Open **http://maker:4001** and let's confirm it in the real collection:

1. You'll see **All** (5 bookmarks). Click **To read**, then **Finished** — the collection splits into the two groups you'd expect.
2. Back on **All**, pick a **To read** item (e.g. **James Webb**) and press **Mark as finished** — its badge flips to *Finished*. Switch to the **Finished** view and you'll find it there; press **Move to To-read** to send it back (fully reversible, nothing deleted).
3. Save a fresh link (e.g. `https://example.org/fresh`) and confirm — it starts life as **To read**.

**Does this match how you want to separate to-read from finished? And does the status sitting alongside search and tags (they all narrow together) feel right?**
